inner_thermal_liner_tpu_85a.structural_purpose: High-tactility thermal-insulating inner glove liner (85A TPU). Sliced at a dense 0.12mm layer step-down to sharply capture the microscopic, three-sided Desert Silver Ant dead-air wells and convective cooling siphons. Enforces a flat 0.00mm Z-hop to maintain absolute physical dimensional accuracy around the protruding male snap-anchor alignment posts.

heavy_carapace_tpu_95a_glass_reinforced.structural_purpose: Modular snap-on heavy impact armor carapace (Glass-Sphere Particle Compounded 95A TPU). Requires a micro-step nozzle temperature bump to 242C to smoothly flow the 35% glass-sphere reinforcement matrix. Hardcodes a dense 5-wall loop boundary layer around the female snap-capture recesses to suppress thermal expansion mismatches, locking the internal locking ridges dead-flat under 220C hot-pipe exposure.
